about: Lead-lined doorset modelled as a product: frame with stops and architraves, leaf as two HPL skins with a lead lining layer (visible on the leaf top and bottom), lipping, lead-glass vision with wide stainless bead, lever and escutcheons, four heavy hinges, heavy closer, kick plates, seals, illuminated warning light on the corridor face (+y) and radiation sign. Geometry drawn at the first type's size; brand, model and supplier open for review. Reference: query: door lead lined xray doors hospital; images: https://www.google.com/search?tbm=isch&q=door+lead+lined+xray+doors+hospital; basis: generic product; brand, model and supplier open for review
